title: Flutter store ledger: every piece of data the Flutter app keeps and how native reads it

statuses.READ: a native file reads the store (nativeReader names it)
statuses.MISSING: native should read it but nothing does yet
statuses.KEPT: kept untouched; native never reads or writes it
statuses.DEFERRED: kept untouched until the feature is ported (01 D6/D7)
statuses.DROPPED: the feature is gone; left in place or removed by the v3 cleanup
statuses.NOT_STORED: a name the scanner sees that is not stored data (route, metadata field, in-memory key)

rules: Every name FlutterStoreScanner finds in the 2.1.4 tree matches a row name or alias (FlutterKeyRegistryTest).
nativeReader is the first native main-source file holding the key literal at the commit that last regenerated the row; READ rows must point at a file that exists.
fallback is the plain-words result the person sees when the value is unreadable.
